021import java.util.Set;
022
023/**
024 * Represents a per-player tag index used for fast lookup of tags and shops.
025 *
026 * <p>This index maintains a bidirectional mapping between shops and tags:</p>
027 * <ul>
028 *   <li>shopId → tags</li>
029 *   <li>tag → shopIds</li>
030 * </ul>
031 *
032 * <p>Implementations are expected to be thread-safe.</p>
033 *
034 * @author creatorfromhell
035 * @since 6.3.0.0
036 */
037public interface PlayerTagIndex {
038
039  /**
040   * Adds a tag entry to the index.
041   *
042   * @param shopId the shop ID
043   * @param tag    the tag
044   *
045   * @since 6.3.0.0
046   */
047  void addTag(long shopId, String tag);
048
049  /**
050   * Removes a tag entry from the index.
051   *
052   * @param shopId the shop ID
053   * @param tag    the tag
054   *
055   * @since 6.3.0.0
056   */
057  void removeTag(long shopId, String tag);
058
059  /**
060   * Returns the tags applied to a shop.
061   *
062   * @param shopId the shop ID
063   *
064   * @return tags associated with the shop
065   *
066   * @since 6.3.0.0
067   */
068  Set<String> getTags(long shopId);
069
070  /**
071   * Returns all shops associated with a tag.
072   *
073   * @param tag the tag
074   *
075   * @return shop IDs containing the tag
076   *
077   * @since 6.3.0.0
078   */
079  Set<Long> getShops(String tag);
080
081  /**
082   * Returns all shop IDs currently tracked by this index.
083   *
084   * @return tracked shop IDs
085   *
086   * @since 6.3.0.0
087   */
088  Set<Long> shops();
089
090  /**
091   * Returns the total number of tags tracked by this index.
092   *
093   * @return total tag count
094   *
095   * @since 6.3.0.0
096   */
097  int totalTags();
098
099  /**
100   * Checks whether a shop has a specific tag.
101   *
102   * @param shopId the shop ID
103   * @param tag    the tag
104   *
105   * @return true if the tag exists
106   *
107   * @since 6.3.0.0
108   */
109  boolean hasTag(long shopId, String tag);
110
111  /**
112   * Clears all cached tag data.
113   *
114   * @since 6.3.0.0
115   */
116  void clear();
117}
